facts.fact: Soren 与 Kit 已维持这种关系十七个月，且只会越来越糟。
facts.anchor: Seventeen months of this and it only gets worse.

facts.fact: 十七个月来 Kit 第一次在性事中喊出 Soren 的名字。
facts.anchor: My name. For the first time in seventeen months, my actual name leaves his mouth

facts.fact: Soren 知道明天是 Kit 二十二岁生日，只因去年听过他二十一岁生日的抱怨。
facts.anchor: Tomorrow is his twenty-second birthday. I only know because of last year

facts.fact: Lorraine 在早餐时问 Soren 今天是否陪 Kit。
facts.anchor: “So… are you going to be spending any time with Kit today?”

facts.fact: Ray 劝 Soren 把关于 Kit 父母的真相告诉他。
facts.anchor: “I know I’ve said it before, but seriously… you need to tell him the truth about his parents.”

facts.fact: Ray 在餐桌旁向 Kit 说生日快乐。
facts.anchor: Ray glances between us, then clears his throat carefully. “Happy birthday, Kit.”

facts.fact: Lorraine 责备 Soren 只顾照顾全家，却因自私忽视唯一被他拉近身边的人。
facts.anchor: “Shame on you, Soren Sinclair. You know how to look after everyone else under this roof

facts.fact: Soren 提议让 Lorraine 陪 Kit 烤蛋糕。
facts.anchor: “I think Lorraine would like to spend some time with you, maybe bake a cake with you.”
